Network Technology Case Studies Fact Sheets and Guides Reports Glossary Trackers and Dashboards Webinars Start Here Digital Opportunity Lab Start a Community Network Sign Up For a Network Educate Your Local Community Subscribe Donate BEAD’s Next Steps: Unpacking State Progress and Challenges - Episode 638 of the Community Broadband Bits Podcast By Jordan Pittman on Mar 4, 2025 In this episode of the podcast, Chris is joined by Heather Mills, Principal Consultant at Tilson Technology Management, to break down the latest developments in the Broadband Equity, Access, and Deployment (BEAD) program. They discuss the evolving landscape of state applications, common misconceptions, and the uncertainties surrounding potential program changes. With states already awarding funds and moving forward, what challenges lie ahead? Tune in for an in-depth conversation on how BEAD is shaping broadband expansion and what’s next for communities nationwide.
